paper_title: Brief Announcement: The Space Complexity of Set Agreement Using Swap
statement: Determining the exact space complexity of solving obstruction-free k-set agreement using swap objects when k > 1 remains an open problem. We conjecture that n − k swap objects are required. Theorem 6 implies that any obstruction-free consensus algorithm from readable swap objects with constant-sized domain requires Ω(n) objects. This asymptotically matches Bowman’s [3] algorithm, which uses 2n − 1 registers with domain size 2.
